verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents a Sandbox Mode parameter in mail_settings that validates a Mail Send request without delivering the email. Agents can therefore test sends without emailing real recipients. However, this is a per-request flag on the production account and API, not a separate sandbox environment isolated from production data. missing for 10: an isolated test environment or account separate from production, sandbox coverage beyond Mail Send (webhooks, templates, contacts), independent or hands-on corroboration.
